description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing component, specifically testing parsing and fallback behaviors for configuration related to provider selection and silence timeout settings.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A suite of tests validating the behavior of TalkConfigParsing related to configuration parsing and default handling.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests that a payload missing the 'resolved' provider configuration is rejected (returns nil).

methods.name: ignoresLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Tests that legacy fields are ignored when the normalized payload lacks certain configurations.

methods.name: readsConfiguredSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Tests that a specified silenceTimeoutMs value is correctly parsed from the configuration.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the fallback silenceTimeoutMs value is used when the configuration is missing.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Tests that an invalid silenceTimeoutMs value defaults to the fallback value.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenBool
methods.description: Tests that a boolean value for silenceTimeoutMs defaults to the fallback value.
